title: PERC Rule for PE
sources: Kline JA et al. J Thromb Haemost 2004; 2008
purpose: In a patient already judged LOW pretest probability, rules out PE with no testing when all 8 criteria are absent.
notes: Only apply when your gestalt pretest probability is already low (< 15%). A score of 0 means PERC-negative; any positive criterion means PERC cannot be used to rule out — proceed to D-dimer or imaging per Wells.

items.label: Recent surgery or trauma (hospitalized within 4 weeks)

interpretation.label: PERC-negative — PE excluded
interpretation.risk: < 2% — no further testing in a low-pretest-probability patient

interpretation.label: PERC-positive — cannot rule out PE by PERC
interpretation.disposition: Proceed to age-adjusted D-dimer or imaging per Wells/YEARS
